_help: Reality checks applied on top of FCC data. Station keys are CALL or CALL@kHz. Fields: off (true), keep (true: keep a Mexican station the CRT license list doesn't show), kw (replace licensed power), adjust_db (add dB to the field), note (shown in the explorer). Country entries take adjust_db/off/note and apply to every station from that country unless the station has its own entry.

CU.note: Cuban powers are old FCC listings, not current notifications; grid failures keep many stations off or at reduced power.

CMBX@1010.note: Listed at 500 kW (Wajay); DXers report never hearing a Cuban on 1010. Treated as a paper allocation.

CMBV@550.note: Listed at 500 kW (Wajay), like CMBX; no evidence Cuba ever ran 500 kW. Treated as a paper allocation.
